repository.description: Get up and running with large language models locally
repository.readme:
# Ollama

Get up and running with large language models on your own machine.

## Quickstart

    ollama run qwen2.5

## Docker

The official image is available as `ollama/ollama`.

## REST API

Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.

Generate a response:

    curl http://localhost:11434/api/generate -d '{"model": "qwen2.5", "prompt": "Why is the sky blue?"}'

Chat with a model: `POST /api/chat` with a list of messages.
